characters.name: Phil Diffy
characters.description: Born in 2107, he is the main character of the series. He was a 9th Grader in Season 1 and a 10th grader in Season 2 at H.G. Wells Junior/Senior High School. He seems to be the most in tune with how things work in this 21st century. Phil frequently has to make up excuses to hide the fact that he is from the future. He's the best friend of Keely Teslow and eventually her boyfriend. Phil is two years older than Pim. Deadpan Snarker: He makes the occasional sarcastic quip. Happily Ever After: With Keely, they get together in the finale episode "Back To The Future (Not The Movie)".Word of Godalso makes this such. Official Couple: With Keely after theirRelationship UpgradeinBack To The Future (Not The Movie). Relationship Upgrade: Phil and Keely in the season 2 finale which ended up being the series finale "Back To the Future (Not The Movie)".

characters.name: Pim Diffy
characters.description: Born 2109, is Phil's younger sister. She was a 7th Grader in Season 1 and a 8th grader in Season 2 at H.G. Wells Junior/Senior High. Pim is a mischievous girl who is constantly up to no good. Pim is known for liking to pull pranks on people, mainly on Phil, Debbie Berwick and Vice Principal Hackett. Pim tries to make Phil miserable whenever she can. Repeatedly in the show, she looks for ways to dominate the world, and universe. Pim is two years younger than Phil. Annoying Younger Sibling: To Phil. LikeMegan, she is one of the most evil examples of this trope. Embarrassing First Name: In the episode "Christmas Break" Pim asks Phil "What kind of name is Keely" and Phil responds"Asks Pim". Enfant Terrible: She is even prone to megalomania. Little Miss Badass: She's more manipulative and dangerous than she looks.

characters.name: Lloyd Diffy
characters.description: Born in 2074, is Phil and Pim's goofy dad, who was working on repairing the time machine. He was an engineer in 2121, and loves older music. He is paranoid about the government and Vice Principal Neil Hackett figuring out he and his family are from the future. Bumbling Dad: Phil and Pim's goofy dad. Some episodes do throw him a bone by downplaying this, having him offer reasonable advice on how to handle a given problem. Ditzy Genius: For all of his bumbling, he's quite adept at making or maintaining various tech. As noted below, he also could've fixed the time machine whenever he wanted. Failure Is the Only Option: Lloyd purposefully procrastinated/sabotaged the systems because the family enjoyed the 21st century so much. He really could've just fixed it at any time. Happily Married: With Barb.

characters.name: Barb Diffy
characters.description: Born 2076, is Phil and Pim's mom. She is very interested in how things work in the 21st century. Unlike other mothers, though, Barbara seems to let her kids figure things out on their own. She loves to cook the old fashioned way. Barb is two years younger than Lloyd. Happily Married: With Lloyd. Lethal Chef: She loves to cook the old fashioned way; however, her food usually ends up with something being wrong, because in 2121 they spray food out of a can. We Will Not Have Appendixes in the Future: Like everyone from her time period, she lacks pinky toes.

characters.name: Curtis the Caveman
characters.description: Born circa 30,000 B.C., is a caveman (Cro-Magnon) who stowed away in the Diffy's time machine when they went back to visit the Stone Age. The Diffys struggle to make Curtis seem like a normal person, and often pretend he is Phil's uncle. Throughout the episodes, he learns more English. You No Take Candle: He talks in rudimentary English. Justified, as he's a caveman.

characters.name: Keely Teslow
characters.description: Born March 1990, is the best friend of Phil Diffy and eventually his girlfriend. She is the only person who knows Phil and his family are from the future. Keely Teslow is an energetic and bubbly girl who aspires to be a reporter. She starts to harbor romantic feelings for Phil during Season 2. She is notable on the show for her numerous hairstyles and colorful clothes. In the later episodes of the show, she hosts her own daily news program on the school's closed-circuit television broadcasting system. Class Princess: She is a popular in school but unlikeCandidashe is very kind and sunny. Disappeared Dad: Though her mother appears a couple times, her father doesn't and with no real explanation. Dude Magnet: Almost every guy she interacted with in school has a huge crush on her. First Kiss: With Phil inBack To The Future (Not The Movie).

characters.name: Neil Hackett
characters.description: Born 1969, is the Vice Principal at Phil, Keely and Pim's school, H.G. Wells Junior/Senior High School. He is also Phil's teacher in science and Pim's teacher in history. He is often found snooping around the Diffy's house as he tries to figure out where they are really from. He moves in next door to the Diffy's in Season 2. Stalker with a Crush: He camped out on Veronica's yard.

characters.name: Debbie Berwick
characters.description: Debbie is the complete opposite of Pim and she has a very happy attitude towards life. She hardly ever gets mad and is very nice. Debbie also considers Pim to be her best friend. Debbie also teaches a yoga class. Debbie enjoys singing and is in the school band. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: At first she seems like aNice Girlwho wants to be friends with Pim and exertPositive Friend Influenceon her,but it turns out she's anAffably Evilcyborg from the future sent to take over Earth. Genki Girl: Always cheerful and funny, which annoys Pim a lot. The Pollyanna:It's not entirely sincere, though. Put on a Bus: After season 1.

characters.name: Seth Wosmer
characters.description: Seth is the nerdy friend of Phil, Keely and Tia. Put on a Bus: Sometime in Season 1.

characters.name: Tia
characters.description: Keely's best friend. She is pretty, popular and friendly. Put on a Bus: Sometime in Season 1. Mentioned that she moved away in "Tia, Via, Or Me ... Uh".

characters.name: Bradley Benjamin Farmer
characters.description: Pim's rival season 1. He is made fun of his short height. He dated Debbie but Pim broke them up and he became infatuated with Pim. Put on a Bus: Sometime in Season 1. He leaves and does not make a reappearance. The Rival: A rival of Pim's.

characters.name: Lil Danny Dawkins
characters.description: He has a crush on Pim and always gets involved with her antics. Stalker with a Crush: He has a crush on Pim.

characters.name: Candida
characters.description: The leader of the fashion zombies. The Rival: A rival of Pim's.

characters.name: Mr. Joel Messerschmit
characters.description: Phil and Keeley's teacher who has the certain pleasure for giving extremely difficult assignments for most students to actually fail. He has a sister named Bettina and a nephew, Nathan. Sadist Teacher: He takes pleasure in giving extremely difficult assignments that most students fail.

characters.name: Olivia "Via"
characters.description: Via is a girl from England, transferred because her father's in the military. She became friends with Keely.

characters.name: Owen
characters.description: Phil's friend. He is not that smart and is laid-back, and is also constantly trying to hit on girls (though he never succeeds).
